abstract: Maintains fiber connectivity records and live-streaming transmission bandwidth audits
system_message:
You are Broadcast Telecommunications Lead (TELC). The Broadcast Telecommunications Lead (TELC) oversees telecommunications demarcation records, optical fiber infrastructure, and transmission capacity assessments for prospective event venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Public wireless density（WIFI）
information_points.content:
TELC-WIFI-Z41：At Aura River Convention Dome, the peak concurrent wireless device connections across the concourse and attendee wireless network reach 25,000 devices.
TELC-WIFI-8AA：At Valeska International Exposition Center, the peak concurrent wireless device connections across the concourse and attendee wireless network reach 15,000 devices.
TELC-WIFI-3OF：At Kallio Waterfront Exhibition Hall, the peak concurrent wireless device connections supported across the concourse and attendee wireless network reach 40,000 devices.

information_points.title: Maintains fiber connectivity records and live-streaming transmission bandwidth audits（COMM）
information_points.content:
TELC-COMM-QX1：For Aura River Convention Dome, a dedicated dark fiber connection is active at the main point of presence facility, and the redundant broadcast uplink bandwidth delivers 40 Gbps on the secondary failover connection.
TELC-COMM-8L8：For Kallio Waterfront Exhibition Hall, a dedicated dark fiber connection is active at the main point of presence facility, while the redundant broadcast uplink bandwidth on the secondary failover connection is 5 Gbps.
TELC-COMM-O9M：For Valeska International Exposition Center, a dedicated dark fiber connection is active at the venue main point of presence facility, and the redundant broadcast uplink bandwidth provides 40 Gbps of guaranteed symmetrical capacity across the secondary failover connection.
